description: Export an AbaNinja quote (Offerte) — or an invoice with document: 'invoice' — as PDF and file it as a CallPilotAI document. quote: the quote number (e.g. 'OF0001') or its uuid. Optional entity + entity_id (e.g. lead, account, asbest_project) to attach the document to a record. Returns document_id (pass it to send_email as attachments to mail it), a download link valid 24 h, file name and size. Changes nothing in AbaNinja; the same unchanged quote is filed only once.

document.description: Document type to export: quote (default) or invoice

entity.description: Optional record type to attach to (lead, account, contact, asbest_project, …).

entity_id.description: Id of that record — required together with entity.

name: get_abaninja_quote_pdf
